headline: Allentown approves property tax increase to fund police, roads
summary: Allentown City Council voted to raise property taxes by 1.5 mills, the first increase since 2022. The revenue will be used to hire 15 new police officers and fund road repair projects across the city.

headline: State awards $12 million for Bethlehem Steel site redevelopment
summary: Pennsylvania has awarded a $12 million grant for redevelopment of the former Bethlehem Steel site on the city's South Side. The project includes housing, retail, and public green space along the Lehigh River.

headline: Lehigh Valley municipalities receive first opioid settlement payments
summary: Allentown, Bethlehem, and Easton each received their first payments from the national opioid settlement this week. Allentown will receive $2.1 million over the next 18 years, with funds earmarked for addiction treatment and prevention programs.

headline: PA budget talks stall over education funding formula
summary: State budget negotiations in Harrisburg have stalled over disagreements about the education funding formula. Lehigh Valley lawmakers say the current proposal would shortchange suburban districts while favoring Philadelphia and Pittsburgh.
